name: krw-ontology
description: Source-grounded equity research ontology tools for 10-K and 10-Q evidence retrieval.

interface.longDescription: Provides read-only MCP tools and agent guidance for querying KRW ontology data, tracing claims to quotes and spans, inspecting quality signals, and comparing companies.

Trace this ontology object to source quotes.
Compare VG and XOM capex evidence.
